text:
maya: quick sync — need a controlled bench comparing 1.22 runtime vs 1.21 for our hybrid quant path (int4->int8 fallback, plus fp8 variant). suspecting a perf regression in p95 for nv4. can someone run a reproducible sweep and drop results here? include latency p50/p95, tps, and quality deltas on small_squad + summarization promptset. async is fine.

zane: I can run today. target machine nv4? or should I use a100 for headroom?

maya: nv4 preferred to match the canary environment. if it OOMs fall back to a100 and note it.

arjun: I'll assemble the bench script. which batch sizes and seq lengths? also want clear labels for kernel variant.

maya: batches [1,4,8,16], seq 512. run both kernel variants: legacy and new-kernel-2026. warmup kv-cache 200 requests for warm vs cold scenarios. label metadata: kernel=legacy|new-kernel-2026, quant=int4|int8|fp8, batch=..

zane: copying. will run int4 first then int8 baseline then fp8. separate runs for clarity.

zane: preliminary command I'm using:
```
bench_runner \\
  --model gptx-small \\
  --variant new-kernel-2026 \\
  --quant int4 \\
  --batch-sizes 1,4,8,16 \\
  --seq-len 512 \\
  --warmup 200 \\
  --seed 42 \\
  --eval-s3 s3://redwood-evals/quant/small_squad \\
  --out s3://redwood-results/bench/2123456789/int4.json
```

arjun: nice. i'll add headers to capture model-variant and routing tags. also will ensure perfetto traces and jemalloc stats are uploaded.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: bench-run-2123456789-int4 (nv4, new-kernel-2026). ETA ~40m. logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/bench-run-2123456789

sara: can we also capture tokens/sec and token lat distribution? need to correlate with routing logs for cost analysis.

arjun: adding token/sec and x-ray headers. also enabling verbose kernel timers.

qa-ci: When the run completes i'll kick off scoring against summarization/round1 and push a quality.csv to the results path. Please keep the raw predictions.

zane: int4 run finished (nv4, new-kernel-2026). quick metrics: p50 48ms, p95 132ms, tokens/sec 320. attached small snippet: 
``
metrics: p50=48ms p95=132ms tps=320 mem=12.2GB
``
quality: raw evals uploaded to s3://redwood-results/bench/2123456789/int4/preds.json

maya: thanks. qa-ci when you have quality numbers drop delta vs int8 baseline. our pass criteria: regression <= 0.5% on ROUGE/BLEU and max latency p95 no more than +10% vs baseline.

qa-ci: started scoring. will post CSV once done.

zane: starting int8 baseline now (same kernel variants). will tag results accordingly.

arjun: small note — ensure environment var QUANT_FALLBACK=1 for the hybrid matrix so int4 fallbacks to int8 as expected.

zane: noted and set.

ops-bot: bench-run-2123456789-int8 scheduled. logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/bench-run-2123456789-int8

zane: int8 run complete. p50 46ms, p95 118ms, tokens/sec 355. uploaded to s3://redwood-results/bench/2123456789/int8/

qa-ci: scoring done. short summary: int4 vs int8 on small_squad — answer-f1 delta = -0.4% (within threshold). summarization ROUGE-L delta = -0.6% (slightly above threshold). attaching quality.csv at s3://redwood-results/bench/2123456789/quality.csv

maya: hmm summarization delta slightly over. can you break down by prompt category? maybe tail prompts or long context are causing drift.

\qa-ci: breaking down now — looks like long-instruction prompts (len>400) account for most of the drop. will share per-prompt CSV.

arjun: that suggests kernel quant matmul precision on long-seq steps; i'll run a focused long-seq int4 test with seq 1024 and include FP accumulation toggles.

sara: if int4 fails on long seq, let's test fp8 variant to see if we recover quality while keeping perf. we should capture cost delta per 1M tokens too.

zane: starting fp8 run with new-kernel-2026. will label quant=fp8 and include cost calc.

zane: fp8 run complete. p50 43ms, p95 125ms, tokens/sec 380. quality: summarization delta = -0.2% vs int8 baseline. results in s3://redwood-results/bench/2123456789/fp8/

maya: great — fp8 looks promising for long-context. can someone draft a short canary plan if we want to validate this in prod traffic? include traffic %, healthchecks, rollback thresholds.

arjun: I'll open PR with canary plan + rollout steps and add kernel fallback to legacy if error rate >0.5% and latency p95 > baseline*1.15. PR shortly: https://github.com/redwood/rt/pull/4921

sara: I'll add route-level observability checks and a dashboard widget for the canary.

zane: summary attachment: int8 baseline p95=118ms, int4 p95=132ms (quality small regression on long seq), fp8 p95=125ms with quality within threshold.

maya: perfect. next actions: 1) arjun opens PR for canary (link above). 2) sara adds dashboard & alerts. 3) ops to schedule limited canary with rollback hooks. 4) QA run full promptset sweep post-canary.

ops-bot: milestone created: quant-canary-2123456789. Tasks assigned: arjun (PR), sara (dash + alerts), ops (canary execution), qa-ci (full sweep).

maya: thanks all — this was helpful. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
